A '''''Consular''-class cruiser''' was part of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], first used by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] to transfer [[Mission to Rodia/Legends|arrested]] [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] from [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] to the [[Tranquility/Legends|''Tranquility'']]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Faro Argyus/Legends|Faro Argyus]] later stole the [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|cruiser]] following his [[Rescue on the Tranquility/Legends|escape]] with Gunray.
